entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: transient CRL/revocation lookup failure hard-fails SDK bootstrap in CI (TimestampRevocationUnavailable) #55135
  • Clarify intent of Microsoft.Win32.Msi.Manual.Tests: real test project (migrate to MTP) or standalone tool (exclude from CI)? #55132

Closed

  • Cannot run dotnet core WinForms app on .Net 6.0 #24503
    Backlog
  • Can't disable timeline view on `dotnet test` with MTP #52114
  • [10.0.101] `dnx`/`dotnet tool exec` not Authenticating on Private NuGet feed #51375

PullRequests

Created

  • Use IsTestingPlatformApplication for MTP detection #55134

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55129
  • Add F# hot reload support to dotnet-watch #55128

Merged

  • Shave 200+ms off cost to `POST` telemetry using proper connection str #55127

  • Delete `.merge_file_JsDg5L` #55112

Updated
